Research US stablecoin adoption with an agent
A Manus agent connected to Heurist's mesh ran deep research on US stablecoin adoption in 2026 after one approval step, finishing in two minutes.
Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
A Manus agent was given a Heurist Mesh skill. It submitted the deep research job on US stablecoin adoption in 2026, paid $0.10 USDC through Inflow for the query, and ran autonomously after one user approval.
How it went
Full analysis was delivered in two minutes.
Worth knowing
One approval and $0.10 USDC were required.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Run deep research on [topic, e.g. stablecoin adoption in the US in 2026]. Cover [key angles such as usage numbers, regulation, major players, and risks], use recent and credible sources, and cite each one. Finish with a one-page report with a short summary at the top and a list of open questions; if you need my approval for any tool or data source, ask before proceeding.
